description: Elections Commission - E. M. D. P. Edirisingha of the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - R. P. D. N. K. Nandasiri of the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that two members of the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes as it involves the status of elected local government officials under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically addressing vacancies in elected positions.
